text: The Patriots face the Bills in Week 4 without two critical defensive pieces, as Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore have been ruled out due to shoulder injuries, forcing Mike Reiss to break down how New England plans to replace them against Josh Allen, while the offensive line takes another hit with Greg Van Roten placed on injured reserve with a thigh injury—all of this as Drake Maye insists his own right shoulder is fine and he's focused on making better decisions to turn around the team's 1-2 start. On a brighter note, Mack Hollins earned the Week 4 NFLPA Community MVP award after hosting a Special Olympics Family Field Day for over 100 athletes and their families, and Matt Pryor is set to join the Patriots offense as the roster continues its reshuffling ahead of Sunday's matchup in Buffalo.
